description: This file defines the React Native component 'NotesListScreen', which displays a list of notes, allows search, refresh, and navigation to view or create notes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads notes from the repository, either searching or listing all based on the query.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Handles the pull-to-refresh action, reloads data from the repository.

methods.name: renderItem
methods.description: Renders individual note items in the list as touchable cards.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Component rendered when there are no notes to display.
